description: Gets the project pages and components XML, with information of the currently focused page or component. These referenced nodeIds can be used with getNodeXml to get the XML of a specific page or component.
name: getProjectXml

description: Gets the currently selected node IDs
name: getSelectionXml

description: Zooms the canvas to center on the given node ID.
name: zoomIntoView

description: Get a specific Framer node as XML. You first need to get a node id via getProjectXml or getSelectedNode.
name: getNodeXml

description: Updates the XML for a specific node using its nodeId and the provided new XML string. It can be used to update nodes text or attributes.
name: updateXmlForNode
